text.tspan: Part C: what traceroute and a "don't fragment" ping really do
use other probes: the same three hops
r2 drops its time-exceeded messages → hop 2 shows *
but hop 3 still answers: the path works
ping blocked does not mean the service is down
the next 1500-byte ping fails locally: message too long
